title: Uncurrying a transpose, precomposing and evaluating in a monoidal closed category
statement:
Let $C$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with tensor $\otimes$ and, for each object $A$, a chosen right adjoint $[A,-]$ to $A\otimes-$. Write $\operatorname{curry}:\operatorname{Hom}(A\otimes X,Y)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(X,[A,Y])$ for the adjunction bijection, natural in $X$ and $Y$, and $\operatorname{uncurry}$ for its inverse. For every $u:A\otimes X\to Y$,
$$\operatorname{uncurry}(\operatorname{curry}(u))=u.$$
For every $a:X\to X'$ and $v:X'\to[A,Y]$,
$$\operatorname{uncurry}(a;v)=(1_A\otimes a);\operatorname{uncurry}(v).$$
Here $a;v$ means first $a$, then $v$. Write $\mathrm{ev}_{A,Y}:A\otimes[A,Y]\to Y$ for the counit of this adjunction at $Y$ (evaluation). For every $v:X\to[A,Y]$,
$$\operatorname{uncurry}(v)=(1_A\otimes v);\mathrm{ev}_{A,Y}.$$
